================================================================================
implicit call with single argument
================================================================================

console.log msg

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement_sequence
    (statement
      (expression_statement
        (expression
          (implicit_call
            (expression
              (member_expression
                (expression
                  (identifier))
                (identifier)))
            (expression
              (identifier))))))))

================================================================================
nested implicit calls are right-associative
================================================================================

foo bar baz

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement_sequence
    (statement
      (expression_statement
        (expression
          (implicit_call
            (expression
              (identifier))
            (expression
              (implicit_call
                (expression
                  (identifier))
                (expression
                  (identifier))))))))))

================================================================================
implicit call argument absorbs binary operators
================================================================================

foo a + b

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement_sequence
    (statement
      (expression_statement
        (expression
          (implicit_call
            (expression
              (identifier))
            (expression
              (binary_expression
                (expression
                  (identifier))
                (expression
                  (identifier))))))))))

================================================================================
spaced minus is subtraction, not an implicit call
================================================================================

a - b

              (identifier))))))))
